lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots located posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a staggered grid with the largest centroids appearing in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regularized geometric grid across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear ridge feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral boundary, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity light on the upper edge to deep shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, irregular reddish-orange patch of pixels is located on the mid-lateral flank, intersecting the spot pattern posterior to the fourth and fifth gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of micro-scale high-luminance spots is visible on the cranial region, showing a significant reduction in size and increase in frequency compared to the flank patterning.
